text: A group project starts tomorrow. What is your first move?

options.text: Take the lead and divide up the work.
Make a plan before anyone starts.
Check what everyone needs help with.
Pitch an idea nobody has tried before.

text: Your friends have a free Saturday. You suggest…

options.text: A spontaneous trip somewhere new.
Our favourite place, with the whole group.
An escape room with a proper challenge.
Making something: music, art, or a small game.

text: A plan goes wrong at the last minute. You…

options.text: Stay calm and work out what changed.
Make a quick decision and get moving.
Make sure nobody feels left on their own.
Improvise a completely different solution.

text: Which compliment would mean the most to you?

options.text: You always have my back.
You see things in a different way.
You make difficult things look simple.
You are brave enough to go for it.

text: You have to learn a new skill. How do you begin?

options.text: Jump in and learn by trying.
Find a guide and follow a clear routine.
Learn with a friend and help each other.
Experiment and develop my own approach.

text: A friend comes to you after a difficult day. You…

options.text: Listen and remind them I am here for them.
Help them break the problem into small steps.
Encourage them to face the issue directly.
Find an unexpected way to make them smile.

text: In a game, what feels most satisfying?

options.text: A bold move that changes everything.
A carefully planned strategy working out.
Helping the whole team win together.
Winning with an unusual combination.

text: Two teammates disagree. What do you do?

options.text: Hear both sides and look for common ground.
Say what I think and help make a decision.
Support the person who is being overlooked.
Suggest a third option neither considered.

text: You discover a mysterious door in an adventure game. You…

options.text: Open it. That is where the adventure is.
Look for clues before touching anything.
Wait until the whole party is ready.
Try to find a secret entrance around it.

text: A deadline is getting close. Your usual approach is…

options.text: Work through my checklist, one task at a time.
Bring everyone together for a final push.
Finish my part and help someone who is behind.
Find a clever way to simplify the whole task.

text: What matters most when you join a new team?

options.text: Trust: people look out for one another.
Direction: we know what we want to achieve.
Freedom: unusual ideas are welcome.
Energy: people are ready to take a chance.

text: Pick the motto that sounds most like you.

options.text: Be the person others can rely on.
Think ahead. Stay calm. Make it count.
A little courage can change everything.
There is always another way to do it.
